text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — spotted a tokenization regression affecting a subset of streaming completions. Patch built: `redwood/runtime:hotfix-20260320-1`.
Maya: How widespread?
Alex: ~1.8% of traffic hitting a specific seq-len path, but error mode causes bad completions for high-context requests — starting to see customer tickets.
Jon: Can we restrict to a region/model variant first?
Alex: Plan: canary 2% us-east1, if green -> 20% -> full. Need expedited approval to run outside the normal 24h change window (customer SLA impact).
Carla: I can sign off for a limited canary in US + EU, but want a clear rollback trigger and runbook attached.
Alex: Rollback plan attached inline: immediate rollback command to previous runtime image and pin model: ```./deploy --rollback --image=redwood/runtime:v2.1.14 && ./infra pin-model --model-id=redwood-small --version=2.1.14``` If any metric breach, ops-trigger rollback.
Deploy-bot: [deploy request] Received from Alex. CI: green. Requested: expedited canary (2% in us-east1). Waiting for approvals.
Maya: SRE +1. Set alert thresholds: p95 > 400ms or error rate > 0.5% => auto-rollback. Add a temporary grafana dashboard link in thread.
Jon: Also request a model-pin to avoid auto-fallback to larger model during canary (we saw that change before).
Carla: Please add a one-line release note and internal changelog link before rollout.
Alex: Draft release note: "hotfix: fix tokenization regression causing malformed completions for long-context streams; safe rollout via canary." Changelog: https://redwood.internal/changelogs/2026-03-20-hotfix
Ops-bot: Deploy scheduled at 1793457090 by Alex (expedited). Canary target: us-east1, 2%.
Maya: Monitoring ready. I'll watch p50/p95 and error stream. Ping me with @Maya for any manual escalation. :thumbsup:
Jon: Approving canary. If canary stable for 15m, approve 20% rollout.
Carla: Approving rollout plan for limited canary and rollback procedure. Postmortem on-call if we hit rollback.
Alex: Starting canary now.
Deploy-bot: [canary started] Instances: 12, health checks passing.
Deploy-bot: [metrics] p50=95ms, p95=220ms, errors=0.2% (baseline 0.1%). Watching for 15m.
Alex: Trigger conditions reiterated: rollback if p95>400ms or errors>0.5% sustained for >3m.
Maya: I'm standing by. @Deploy-bot hook should notify in-thread on thresholds.
Deploy-bot: [canary complete - green] Promoted to 20% per escalation policy.
Jon: Looks good so far; schedule 100% promotion in 30m if no regressions.
Carla: Remember to tag repo and add short release note to internal docs.
Alex: Tagging git: `git tag hotfix/2026-03-20-1` and pushing changelog now.
Ops-bot: Promotion scheduled at 1793458920 unless any rollback events occur.
Maya: Approved across SRE. Keep me looped.
